title: NASA | Earthrise: The 45th Anniversary
summary: NASA Goddard recreates the Apollo 8 Earthrise moment using Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter data, narrated by Andrew Chaikin and synced with the astronauts' recorded conversation. It marks the flight's 45th anniversary.
why: Linked as a visualization of how the famous Earthrise photo was taken.

quote.text: Wikipedia links to a nice visualization on youtube of the moments when the photo was taken
